'''Turmok''' was a intelligent [[Exogorth/Legends|Exogorth]] which was created by a mutation. Turmok was once attempted to be [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] by [[slug hunter]]s but resulted in the slug hunters being shook to [[Death/Legends|death]], then swallowed. A search and rescue team went looking for the hunters but Turmok killed them.<ref name="Smart Space Slug">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020919slug|series=Creature Feature|text=Smart Space Slug}}</ref>
